title: The War Inside the Catholic Church

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.zh: 应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日简报》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: An archbishop in the Catholic Church is accusing Pope Francis himself of being part of the effort to cover up the latest sex abuse scandal.
sentences.zh: 天主教会的一位大主教指控教皇方济各本人参与了掩盖最新性虐待丑闻的行动。

sentences.en: What it means that that accusation is coming from inside the church.
sentences.zh: 这一指控来自教会内部意味着什么？

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, August 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月28日，星期二。

sentences.en: So Pope Francis went on a trip to Ireland that was highly anticipated because in May, Ireland took their first steps to legalize abortion.
sentences.zh: 教皇方济各对爱尔兰进行了一次备受期待的访问，因为在五月份，爱尔兰迈出了将堕胎合法化的第一步。

sentences.en: And so that was seen as a huge sign that the Catholic Church in Ireland was no more in a certain sense.
sentences.zh: 这被视为爱尔兰天主教会某种意义上已不复存在的重大信号。

sentences.en: He was going to have to try and convince the Irish to come back to a church that had treated them not very well.
sentences.zh: 他必须努力说服爱尔兰人回到一个曾对他们并不友好的教会中来。

sentences.en: Ireland had suffered one of the worst sexual abuse crises in all of Europe.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰曾遭受过整个欧洲最严重的性虐待危机之一。

sentences.en: So the Pope had a tough trip ahead of him no matter what.
sentences.zh: 所以无论如何，教皇这次出访都面临着严峻的挑战。

sentences.en: Jason Horowitz is the Rome bureau chief.
sentences.zh: 杰森·霍洛维茨是罗马分社社长。

sentences.en: And then we all wake up on
sentences.zh: 然后我们在

sentences.en: Sunday morning and there's this letter.
sentences.zh: 周日早上醒来，就看到了这封信。

sentences.en: So this letter is a more than 7,000 word essentially screed against Pope Francis and his allies in the American church, in the Vatican.
sentences.zh: 这封信长达7000多字，本质上是一篇针对教皇方济各及其在美国教会和梵蒂冈盟友的檄文。

sentences.en: And it's a sort of nuclear bomb that immediately becomes the focus of Francis's trip to Ireland.
sentences.zh: 它就像一颗核弹，立即成为了方济各爱尔兰之行的焦点。

sentences.en: I just want to begin by asking you about a story that's been emerging overnight, allegations being leveled against the Pope.
sentences.zh: 我想先问你一个昨晚浮出水面的新闻，即针对教皇的指控。

sentences.en: Tell us about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我们讲讲这件事。

sentences.en: Three things immediately stood out.
sentences.zh: 有三点立即引起了注意。

sentences.en: The first was the accusation by Archbishop
sentences.zh: 第一点是维加诺大主教的指控，

sentences.en: Viganò that Pope Francis had actually personally covered up the abuse of Cardinal Theodore McCarrick of the United States.
sentences.zh: 称教皇方济各实际上亲自掩盖了美国西奥多·麦卡里克枢机主教的虐待行为。

sentences.en: Who, of course, resigned just a month ago as a cardinal in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 他当然在一个月前刚刚辞去了华盛顿特区枢机主教的职务。

sentences.en: The allegations surrounded the abuse of some seminary students.
sentences.zh: 这些指控围绕着对一些神学院学生的虐待。

sentences.en: McCarrick had been abusing seminarians and that Francis had this knowledge as far back as 2013.
sentences.zh: 麦卡里克一直在虐待神学生，而方济各早在2013年就知情了。

sentences.en: The other accusation is that Francis's predecessor, Pope Benedict XVI, actually sanctioned McCarrick.
sentences.zh: 另一项指控是，方济各的前任教皇本笃十六世实际上曾制裁过麦卡里克。

sentences.en: That his abuse was so known inside the church that the predecessor to Francis sanctioned him.
sentences.zh: 他的虐待行为在教会内部广为人知，以至于方济各的前任对他进行了制裁。

sentences.en: And then the third thing is kind of linked to both of them, which is because this sex abuse scandal is so damaging
sentences.zh: 第三点与前两点都有关联，即因为这起性虐待丑闻对教会的伤害太大，

sentences.en: to the church, there's only one thing to be done, and that is that Pope Francis and his allies who facilitated him, they all need to resign.
sentences.zh: 只有一件事可做，那就是教皇方济各及其协助他的盟友，他们都必须辞职。

sentences.en: So that doesn't happen every day.
sentences.zh: 这种事可不是每天都会发生的。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, Jason, is this Archbishop who wrote this letter the only figure behind it?
sentences.zh: 那么，杰森，写这封信的大主教是幕后的唯一人物吗？

sentences.en: Or is this representing something larger?
sentences.zh: 还是说这代表了更大的势力？

sentences.en: Well, the Archbishop signed the letter himself, but he is in a way speaking for a faction inside
sentences.zh: 嗯，大主教本人签署了这封信，但他某种程度上代表了梵蒂冈内部的一个派系，

sentences.en: the Vatican that very much thinks that the Pope is taking the church in a terrible direction that could ultimately even eventually lead to schism.
sentences.zh: 他们非常认为教皇正在将教会引向一个可怕的方向，最终甚至可能导致分裂。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And how does the Pope respond to this bombshell set of accusations in this letter?
sentences.zh: 教皇对这封信中这一连串重磅指控有何回应？

sentences.en: You know, obviously the reporters who are following Pope Francis around Ireland are talking about nothing else but this letter.
sentences.zh: 你知道，显然那些跟随教皇方济各在爱尔兰访问的记者们谈论的只有这封信。

sentences.en: And typically on the flight back to Rome, Pope Francis gives a press conference in which he talks about the trip and then answers questions.
sentences.zh: 通常在飞回罗马的航班上，教皇方济各会举行新闻发布会，谈论这次访问并回答问题。

sentences.en: Usually there's a lot of disagreement about what needs to be asked.
sentences.zh: 通常对于该问什么会有很多分歧。

sentences.en: This time there was no disagreement.
sentences.zh: 但这次没有分歧。

sentences.en: Clearly the question was, are the allegations in this letter true?
sentences.zh: 显然问题就是：这封信中的指控是真的吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And surprisingly, the Pope dodges.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，教皇回避了。

sentences.en: And he says what essentially comes down to, I won't dignify that question with a response.
sentences.zh: 他所说的本质上就是：我不会屈尊回应那个问题。

sentences.en: I will not say a single word on this.
sentences.zh: 对此我不会说一个字。

sentences.en: Jason, how does something like this happen?
sentences.zh: 杰森，这种事是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: Because we think of Pope Francis as beloved around the world and beyond that as kind of a figure inside the Catholic Church beyond reproach.
sentences.zh: 因为我们认为教皇方济各在世界各地深受爱戴，而且作为天主教会内部的人物，他几乎无可指责。

sentences.en: So what's the back story?
sentences.zh: 那么背景故事是什么？

sentences.en: Well, I think it's worth remembering that when Francis was elected in 2013, he immediately won the adoration of Catholics and really much of the world just for being so different.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为值得记住的是，当方济各在2013年当选时，他仅仅因为表现得如此与众不同，就立即赢得了天主教徒乃至全世界大部分人的崇拜。

sentences.en: First Pope ever from South America.
sentences.zh: 他是历史上第一位来自南美的教皇。

sentences.en: You know, he speaks with this very kind of soft and lilting Argentine accent, comes out on the balcony.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他说话带着一种非常柔和、抑扬顿挫的阿根廷口音，出现在阳台上。

sentences.en: And even I think his first words were, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想他说的第一句话甚至是，你知道，

sentences.en: Buonasera, good evening.
sentences.zh: “晚上好”。

sentences.en: And that just seems so colloquial and normal.
sentences.zh: 这看起来非常通俗和平常。

sentences.en: And immediately he affects this sort of humbleness and this aura of normality.
sentences.zh: 他立即展现出一种谦逊和一种平凡的气质。

sentences.en: He was the guy who took the bus, right?
sentences.zh: 他就是那个坐公交车的人，对吧？

sentences.en: When he was in Buenos Aires, instead of kind of being limoed around, he took the bus everywhere.
sentences.zh: 当他在布宜诺斯艾利斯时，他没有坐豪华轿车到处走，而是到处都坐公交车。

sentences.en: So he had this very much man of the people vibe.
sentences.zh: 所以他有一种非常亲民的氛围。

sentences.en: There's so much new about this.
sentences.zh: 这其中有很多新鲜的东西。

sentences.en: It's a Latin American for the first time.
sentences.zh: 这是第一次由拉丁美洲人担任。

sentences.en: It's a Jesuit for the first time.
sentences.zh: 这是第一次由耶稣会士担任。

sentences.en: He's taken the name of St. Francis for the first time, which is clearly a signal that he wants to show a different face of the church, face of the poor.
sentences.zh: 他第一次采用了圣方济各的名字，这显然是一个信号，表明他想展示教会不同的一面，即贫穷的一面。

sentences.en: So right off the bat, his popularity is through the roof.
sentences.zh: 所以从一开始，他的受欢迎程度就爆棚了。

sentences.en: People are talking about a Francis effect that by the pure force of his personality, people are going to start pouring into the churches again, and the pews will be packed.
sentences.zh: 人们在谈论“方济各效应”，即凭借他的人格魅力，人们将开始涌入教堂，长椅将会坐满。

sentences.en: But even in the very beginning, there is a group of prelates, cardinals, bishops, priests, also just some conservatives around Rome who are a little bit wary of this guy.
sentences.zh: 但即使在最开始，也有一群高级教士、枢机主教、主教、神父，还有罗马周围的一些保守派，他们对这个人有点警惕。

sentences.en: And then he comes back from Brazil, which was his first foreign trip as Pope in July 2013.
sentences.zh: 然后他在2013年7月结束了作为教皇的首次出访，从巴西回来。

sentences.en: The unusually frank press conference on the flight home from Brazil covered a lot of ground over 80 minutes.
sentences.zh: 在从巴西回国的航班上，那场异常坦率的新闻发布会持续了80分钟，涵盖了广泛的话题。

sentences.en: He's asked a question by a reporter about the gay lobby, the so-called gay lobby.
sentences.zh: 有记者问他关于“同性恋游说团体”，即所谓的“同性恋游说团体”的问题。

sentences.en: And he says this remarkable thing.
sentences.zh: 他说了这句非同寻常的话。

sentences.en: All lobbies are not good, he told reporters.
sentences.zh: “所有的游说团体都不好，”他告诉记者。

sentences.en: But if a person is gay and seeks God and has goodwill, who am I to judge him?
sentences.zh: “但如果一个人是同性恋，寻求上帝并有善意，我有什么资格评判他呢？”

sentences.en: And of course, who am I to judge immediately becomes this emblem of this Pope, right?
sentences.zh: 当然，“我有什么资格评判”立即成为了这位教皇的标志，对吧？

sentences.en: And immediately, people in the secular world, especially in the West, they fall in love with this.
sentences.zh: 世俗世界的人，尤其是在西方，立即爱上了这一点。

sentences.en: This is something new.
sentences.zh: 这是新鲜事物。

sentences.en: Word of the Pope's words traveled around the world quickly.
sentences.zh: 教皇的话语迅速传遍了世界。

sentences.en: Local
sentences.zh: 当地

sentences.en: Catholics say the remarks could represent a shift in tone within the church.
sentences.zh: 天主教徒说，这些言论可能代表了教会内部基调的转变。

sentences.en: And if you're preaching love, you're not going to say like, oh, love except, you know, homosexuals.
sentences.zh: 如果你宣扬爱，你就不会说，哦，爱，除了，你知道，同性恋者。

sentences.en: You know, it's love everybody.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是爱所有人。

sentences.en: And just like what he said, who is he to judge?
sentences.zh: 就像他说的，他有什么资格评判？

sentences.en: It is the now familiar change of style of this Pope that has made him such an international headline getter.
sentences.zh: 正是这位教皇现在为人熟知的风格转变，使他成为了国际头条新闻的焦点。

sentences.en: But back in the Vatican, there's that group of conservatives who are not delighted at all by this.
sentences.zh: 但在梵蒂冈，那群保守派对此一点也不高兴。

sentences.en: And they see this as a huge warning that, uh-oh, maybe we got something more than we bargained for here.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是一个巨大的警告，噢，糟糕，也许我们得到的比我们预想的要多。

sentences.en: So in this single comment, progressives inside and outside the church see the Pope that they had hoped for.
sentences.zh: 所以在这单一的评论中，教会内外的进步派看到了他们所希望的教皇。

sentences.en: And these traditionalists start to see the Pope that they had feared.
sentences.zh: 而这些传统主义者开始看到他们所恐惧的教皇。

sentences.en: I think that that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想那是对的。

sentences.en: So then what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么后来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So the Pope continues to essentially ride high, his popularity is high, and he keeps on doing things that
sentences.zh: 教皇继续保持着高人气，他不断做着一些事情，

sentences.en: make him a huge crowd pleaser, especially for liberals and people who are thirsting for a change in the church.
sentences.zh: 使他深受大众欢迎，特别是对于自由派和渴望教会变革的人来说。

sentences.en: But he also does things that make these conservatives think that he's starting to erode the church that they love.
sentences.zh: 但他也做了一些事情，让这些保守派认为他开始侵蚀他们所热爱的教会。

sentences.en: And they start speaking out.
sentences.zh: 他们开始公开表达不满。

sentences.en: And primarily, uh, the person who speaks out the most is an American cardinal who's based in the Vatican.
sentences.zh: 主要来说，呃，发言最多的是一位常驻梵蒂冈的美国枢机主教。

sentences.en: His name is Cardinal Raymond Burke.
sentences.zh: 他的名字是雷蒙德·伯克枢机主教。

sentences.en: There can't be just some kind of an amorphous, this is all just one great family, come on in.
sentences.zh: 不能只是一种模糊的、这都是一个大家庭、快进来吧的感觉。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter who you are, what you do, and so forth.
sentences.zh: 无论你是谁，做什么，等等，这都不重要。

sentences.en: You're part of it.
sentences.zh: 你是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: No, we turn to ChriSt.
sentences.zh: 不，我们要转向基督。

sentences.en: And he is the one who starts talking out on conservative outlets, Catholic television channels,
sentences.zh: 他是在保守派媒体、天主教电视频道上发言最多的人，

sentences.en: sort of saying that, you know, this Pope is saying things that aren't, you know, consistent with the teachings of the Catholic Church.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上说，你知道，这位教皇所说的话，你知道，与天主教会的教义不一致。

sentences.en: So it's really his approach.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实是他的方法。

sentences.en: He's throwing the net out to gather new people, perhaps eyes and ears that have never considered the church.
sentences.zh: 他正在撒网以聚集新人，也许是那些从未考虑过教会的人的眼睛和耳朵。

sentences.en: But you see that then as a call for you, the other bishops, catechists, to redouble your efforts in those areas of Catholic teaching.
sentences.zh: 但你认为那对你们其他主教、教义问答者来说，是在那些天主教教义领域加倍努力的呼吁吗？

sentences.en: That might even be contentious.
sentences.zh: 那甚至可能是引起争议的。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Because the people, even those very people who are being drawn to the church, because they're very much attracted by the approach of Pope Francis,
sentences.zh: 因为人们，即使是那些被吸引到教会的人，因为他们非常被教皇方济各的方法所吸引，

sentences.en: are in need then to hear, well, what is the truth?
sentences.zh: 那么他们也需要听到，嗯，什么是真理？

sentences.en: And all this kind of stays below the radar.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都在雷达之下进行。

sentences.en: These people are not completely disconnected.
sentences.zh: 这些人并非完全脱节。

sentences.en: They are not disconnected.
sentences.zh: 他们没有脱节。

sentences.en: And then 2016 happens.
sentences.zh: 然后2016年到了。

sentences.en: Now to an issue the Catholic Church has grappled with for years.
sentences.zh: 现在谈谈天主教会多年来一直努力解决的一个问题。

sentences.en: It appears Pope Francis may be opening a door for divorced Catholics.
sentences.zh: 看来教皇方济各可能正在为离婚的天主教徒打开一扇门。

sentences.en: The Pope said divorced Catholics who remarry deserve better treatment from the church, and so do their children.
sentences.zh: 教皇说，离婚后重婚的天主教徒应该得到教会更好的对待，他们的孩子也一样。

sentences.en: The Pope releases a papal exhortation, which is essentially a big document, about the family.
sentences.zh: 教皇发布了一份宗座劝谕，本质上是一份关于家庭的重要文件。

sentences.en: In the footnotes of the document, the Pope signals a possible path for divorced Catholics to receive Holy Communion,
sentences.zh: 在文件的脚注中，教皇暗示了离婚天主教徒领受圣餐的可能途径，

sentences.en: writing, the Eucharist is not a prize for the perfect, but a powerful medicine and nourishment for the weak.
sentences.zh: 写道：圣餐不是完美者的奖赏，而是弱者强大的药物和滋养。

sentences.en: And that might sound like no big deal if you're not inside the church.
sentences.zh: 如果你不在教会内部，这听起来可能没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: But for this group of really orthodox conservatives, this is an earthquake.
sentences.zh: 但对于这群真正的正统保守派来说，这是一场地震。

sentences.en: This is a disaster.
sentences.zh: 这是一场灾难。

sentences.en: We're talking about fundamentally a situation of someone who's living in a state contradictory to one of the most fundamental teachings of the faith.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的本质上是一个人的处境，他生活在与信仰最基本教义之一相矛盾的状态中。

sentences.en: Because this is the crack in the doctrine, the way they see it, that could split the whole thing up.
sentences.zh: 因为在他们看来，这是教义上的裂痕，可能会导致整个体系的分裂。

sentences.en: That if you start messing around with things that are supposed to be sacred, including the sanctity of marriage, then what's next?
sentences.zh: 如果你开始摆弄那些本应神圣的东西，包括婚姻的神圣性，那接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: And so this is the thing around which conservatives begin to rally.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是保守派开始团结起来的事情。

sentences.en: And how did Pope Francis respond to this kind of growing sense of outrage among these traditional folks in the Vatican?
sentences.zh: 教皇方济各是如何回应梵蒂冈这些传统人士中日益增长的愤怒感的？

sentences.en: So Pope Francis responded by enraging them even further by not responding.
sentences.zh: 教皇方济各通过不回应，进一步激怒了他们。

sentences.en: He essentially ignored them.
sentences.zh: 他基本上无视了他们。

sentences.en: And they're not used to being ignored.
sentences.zh: 而他们不习惯被忽视。

sentences.en: And so that engenders huge animosity.
sentences.zh: 所以这引发了巨大的敌意。

sentences.en: This fall, more than a dozen cardinals and bishops from around the world will publish books defending church doctrine.
sentences.zh: 今年秋天，来自世界各地的十几位枢机主教和主教将出版捍卫教会教义的书籍。

sentences.en: And nearly 500 priests in Britain are urging church leaders to issue a clear and firm proclamation against communion for divorced couples.
sentences.zh: 英国有近500名神父敦促教会领袖发布明确而坚定的声明，反对离婚夫妇领受圣餐。

sentences.en: And then this year, the sex abuse crisis flares up again.
sentences.zh: 然后今年，性虐待危机再次爆发。

sentences.en: We are following breaking news this morning coming out of the Vatican.
sentences.zh: 我们正在关注今天早上来自梵蒂冈的突发新闻。

sentences.en: We have learned that former D.C.
sentences.zh: 我们获悉，前华盛顿特区

sentences.en: Archbishop Cardinal Theodore McCarrick has resigned and the Pope has accepted his resignation.
sentences.zh: 大主教西奥多·麦卡里克枢机主教已经辞职，教皇已经接受了他的辞呈。

sentences.en: McCarrick is facing several sex abuse allegations.
sentences.zh: 麦卡里克面临多项性虐待指控。

sentences.en: Church bells ring out, marking the first Sunday mass since a new report alleging widespread child sex abuse by Pennsylvania clergy.
sentences.zh: 教堂钟声响起，标志着自一份指控宾夕法尼亚州神职人员广泛虐待儿童的新报告发布以来的第一个周日弥撒。

sentences.en: A report from a Pennsylvania grand jury released last week claims more than 300 priests sexually abused thousands of children.
sentences.zh: 上周发布的一份宾夕法尼亚州大陪审团报告称，有300多名神父性虐待了数千名儿童。

sentences.en: A report out of Pennsylvania detailing child sex abuse in the Catholic Church has some worshipers now questioning their faith.
sentences.zh: 一份来自宾夕法尼亚州详述天主教会内虐待儿童行为的报告，让一些信徒现在开始质疑他们的信仰。

sentences.en: After saying nothing about this in his sermon in Rome yesterday, today Pope Francis released a letter saying in part,
sentences.zh: 教宗方济各昨天在罗马的布道中对此只字未提，但今天他发布了一封信，其中部分内容提到，

sentences.en: He seems to be grappling with how to respond to this thing and he doesn't seem to be sure-footed.
sentences.zh: 他似乎正在努力应对这件事，而且看起来有些底气不足。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden the Pope that everybody, you know, loved, could do no wrong, seems sort of vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，那位大家都爱戴、似乎永远不会犯错的教宗，看起来竟显得有些脆弱。

sentences.en: And it's in that context that he goes to Ireland.
sentences.zh: 正是在这种背景下，他前往了爱尔兰。

sentences.en: And it's in that context that all of a sudden this letter appears, expressing the viewpoint of these people like Archbishop Vigano, who wrote it, like Cardinal Burke,
sentences.zh: 也正是在这种背景下，这封信突然出现，表达了像撰写此信的维加诺总主教（Archbishop Vigano）以及伯克枢机（Cardinal Burke）这类人的观点，

sentences.en: who's been leading the charge, that these people have been waiting a very long time for their message to break through.
sentences.zh: 而伯克枢机一直冲锋在前，这些人等待他们的信息被传达出来已经很久了。

sentences.en: If you are a critic of Francis, and if you are someone who thinks that he has been detrimental to the church, rather than a source for good,
sentences.zh: 如果你是方济各的批评者，如果你认为他给教会带来的不是福祉而是损害，

sentences.en: the timing of this letter is a beautiful thing, because all of the world's attention is already on him.
sentences.zh: 那么这封信的时机选得非常巧妙，因为全世界的目光都已经聚焦在他身上了。

sentences.en: And now you are wrapping him up in the very thing that people have doubts about, which is his commitment to solving the sex abuse problem in the church.
sentences.zh: 现在，你把他卷入了人们最怀疑的事情中，那就是他解决教会性虐待问题的决心。

sentences.en: So this letter contains very specific allegations that Pope Francis knew about an archbishop's behavior, his sexual abuse in the United States, and didn't do anything about it.
sentences.zh: 所以这封信包含了非常具体的指控，称教宗方济各知晓一位总主教在美国的行为，即他的性虐待行为，却对此置之不理。

sentences.en: That he had a specific knowledge and that he ignored it.
sentences.zh: 称他有明确的知情权，但他选择了无视。

sentences.en: So I guess the obvious question is, regardless of whether or not this letter is politically convenient
sentences.zh: 所以我想最显而易见的问题是，无论这封信在政治上是否合时宜，

sentences.en: as an accusation on behalf of the traditionalists, is that accusation, Jason, true?
sentences.zh: 作为传统派提出的指控，杰森，那个指控是真的吗？

sentences.en: Is there evidence that the Pope was in fact part of a cover-up?
sentences.zh: 是否有证据表明教宗确实参与了掩盖真相？

sentences.en: So this is now what everyone is feverishly trying to figure out.
sentences.zh: 这正是现在每个人都在急切想要弄清楚的问题。

sentences.en: And again, the fact that the Pope gave a non-answer when asked point-blank about it, you know, that has added fuel to this.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，当被直截了当地问到这个问题时，教宗给出了一个非回答，你知道，这更是火上浇油。

sentences.en: And there are lots of reasons to believe that there are flaws in these accusations.
sentences.zh: 而且有很多理由相信这些指控存在漏洞。

sentences.en: But until we have all of the facts, you know, those investigations are going to keep going on.
sentences.zh: 但在我们掌握所有事实之前，你知道，那些调查将会持续进行。

sentences.en: And that's why the Pope's decision not to answer, I wonder if strategically, tactically, that was the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么教宗决定不予回应，我在想，从战略和战术上讲，这是否是正确的做法。

sentences.en: I think that's the question that a lot of people are asking.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是许多人正在提出的问题。

sentences.en: I have to say, it seems sort of counterintuitive that this more traditional conservative wing of the Catholic Church
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，天主教会中这个更传统的保守派系，

sentences.en: is accusing this more progressive Pope of being the one to cover up the church sex abuse scandal.
sentences.zh: 指责这位更进步的教宗掩盖了教会的性虐待丑闻，这似乎有些违背常理。

sentences.en: How do they, these traditionalists, talk about the problem of sexual abuse in the church?
sentences.zh: 他们，这些传统派，是如何谈论教会性虐待问题的？

sentences.en: Well, it's not that the conservatives were responsible for sex abuse in the church by any stretch of the imagination.
sentences.zh: 嗯，绝不是说保守派在任何程度上要为教会的性虐待负责。

sentences.en: But their critique of why there is a sex abuse crisis in the Catholic Church is full of this.
sentences.zh: 但他们对天主教会为何存在性虐待危机的批判，充满了这种论调。

sentences.en: And it's a good portion of the letter is essentially calling for a purge of homosexuals from the Vatican and the priesthood.
sentences.zh: 这封信中有很大一部分内容本质上是在呼吁将同性恋者从梵蒂冈和神职人员中清除出去。

sentences.en: Because in the worldview of Archbishop Vigano and a lot of other conservatives in the Vatican, there is a direct correlation between homosexuality and pedophilia.
sentences.zh: 因为在维加诺总主教和梵蒂冈许多其他保守派的世界观里，同性恋和恋童癖之间存在直接联系。

sentences.en: They think that the reason you have all of these horrible cases happening is because you have homosexuals within the priesthood.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，之所以发生所有这些可怕的案件，是因为神职人员中有同性恋者。

sentences.en: And this is exactly the sort of thing Pope Francis does not want to be talking about.
sentences.zh: 而这正是教宗方济各最不想谈论的事情。

sentences.en: This is what he wanted to move on from.
sentences.zh: 这是他想要翻篇的事情。

sentences.en: This is not the fight that he wants to be fighting.
sentences.zh: 这不是他想要参与的斗争。

sentences.en: So in addition to alleging that Francis helped cover up this sex abuse scandal, it sounds like these conservatives view his open-mindedness and his generosity towards gay people
sentences.zh: 因此，除了指控方济各帮助掩盖这起性虐待丑闻外，听起来这些保守派将他对同性恋者的开放态度和宽容，

sentences.en: as perhaps making this sexual abuse scandal worse, since they see the presence of gay people in the church and in the Vatican as contributing to the original sex abuse problem.
sentences.zh: 视为可能加剧了这起性虐待丑闻，因为他们认为同性恋者在教会和梵蒂冈的存在，助长了最初的性虐待问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想你是对的。

sentences.en: Whereas Francis' view is that this horrible sex abuse crisis is more than anything a symptom of a culture of secrecy.
sentences.zh: 而方济各的观点是，这场可怕的性虐待危机，归根结底是秘密文化的一种症状。

sentences.en: Priests thinking that they have more authority than the people that they're supposed to be preaching to.
sentences.zh: 神职人员认为他们比他们所传教的对象拥有更大的权威。

sentences.en: The way Francis talks about it is that if instead of being in service of the people, you feel like you have authority and power over them, you're going to start abusing them.
sentences.zh: 方济各谈论它的方式是，如果你觉得自己对人们拥有权威和权力，而不是为他们服务，你就会开始虐待他们。

sentences.en: And that's what is destructive in the church.
sentences.zh: 而这正是教会中具有破坏性的东西。

sentences.en: Jason, is this a genuine disagreement between these two groups over what causes sex abuse in the church?
sentences.zh: 杰森，这两派对于教会性虐待成因的争论是真实的吗？

sentences.en: Or is this argument from these traditionalists somehow, at the end of the day, a convenient argument to serve their greater purpose, which we'll be talking to you about,
sentences.zh: 还是说，这些传统派的论点归根结底是为了服务于他们更大的目的，我们稍后会谈到，

sentences.en: which might be to unseat Pope Francis as this letter demands.
sentences.zh: 这可能就是像这封信所要求的那样，罢免教宗方济各。

sentences.en: In other words, is this a true religious disagreement or is this a regular old power struggle?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这究竟是真正的宗教分歧，还是普通的权力斗争？

sentences.en: You know, in this case, I think it is both.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这种情况下，我认为两者皆有。

sentences.en: This group of conservatives and traditionalists that we're talking about, I think that they are sincere in their belief that homosexuality causes lots of problems,
sentences.zh: 我们所谈论的这群保守派和传统派，我认为他们真诚地相信同性恋会导致许多问题，

sentences.en: including sex abuse.
sentences.zh: 包括性虐待。

sentences.en: But it also happens to be, for them, an extremely powerful weapon against Pope Francis.
sentences.zh: 但对他们来说，这也恰好是反对教宗方济各的极其强大的武器。

sentences.en: If not to unseat him, then to distract him, slow him down, damage his influence and his popularity, and keep him from doing the sorts of reforms that they don't want.
sentences.zh: 如果不能罢免他，至少可以分散他的注意力，拖慢他的脚步，损害他的影响力和声望，并阻止他进行他们不想要的那些改革。

sentences.en: If he's mired in this fight and he sort of loses some juice over this, that's a good result for them.
sentences.zh: 如果他陷入这场斗争，并且因此失去了一些动力，这对他们来说是一个好的结果。

sentences.en: So there is clearly, I think, a political element to this.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，这显然有一个政治因素。

sentences.en: Jason, what happens if this growing division between the traditionalists and the people who support Pope Francis, if it's not resolved?
sentences.zh: 杰森，如果传统派和支持教宗方济各的人之间这种日益加剧的分歧得不到解决，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, I don't think it will be resolved.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，我不认为它会得到解决。

sentences.en: I don't see Francis all of a sudden saying, you guys are right, there's too many gays in the priesthood, let's get rid of them.
sentences.zh: 我看不出方济各会突然说，你们是对的，神职人员中同性恋太多了，让我们把他们赶走吧。

sentences.en: I don't see some conservatives here, the ones we've been talking about, I don't see them suddenly saying, you know, you're right, who are we to judge?
sentences.zh: 我也看不出这里的某些保守派，就是我们一直在谈论的那些人，会突然说，你知道，你是对的，我们是谁，有什么资格评判呢？

sentences.en: You know, that's just not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是不可能发生的。

sentences.en: In a way, there is an expiration date here.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这里有一个有效期。

sentences.en: And the question is, is what does Francis achieve before that happens?
sentences.zh: 问题是，方济各在那之前能取得什么成就？

sentences.en: But from the other side, what can they prevent Francis from doing?
sentences.zh: 但从另一方面看，他们能阻止方济各做什么？

sentences.en: You have a giant bureaucracy here in the Curia, which is the Vatican bureaucracy that's run the church for centuries.
sentences.zh: 你这里有一个庞大的官僚机构，即教廷，也就是几个世纪以来一直管理教会的梵蒂冈官僚机构。

sentences.en: The Curia is, you know, if you want to talk about a deep state, it's the deepest state.
sentences.zh: 教廷，你知道，如果你想谈论深层政府，它就是最深层的政府。

sentences.en: They have the ability to slow the gears of the church down, the machine down.
sentences.zh: 他们有能力减缓教会的齿轮，减缓这台机器的运转。

sentences.en: So that's where the opposition to Francis can really manifest itself.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是反对方济各的力量真正可以体现出来的地方。

sentences.en: Jason, I'm struck by where we started this conversation, which was the Pope going to Ireland to try to salvage the reputation and the standing of the Catholic Church.
sentences.zh: 杰森，我们谈话的起点让我印象深刻，那就是教宗前往爱尔兰，试图挽救天主教会的声誉和地位。

sentences.en: If these church leaders, especially the traditionalists, the conservative ones, are worried about the future of the church, wouldn't a huge divide like this one inside the church,
sentences.zh: 如果这些教会领袖，尤其是传统派、保守派，担心教会的未来，难道教会内部这样巨大的分歧，

sentences.en: the one that was exposed by this letter, and an attempt to bring down a sitting pope, wouldn't that be the absolute worst thing for the future of the church?
sentences.zh: 这封信所暴露的分歧，以及试图推翻一位在任教宗，难道这不会是教会未来最糟糕的事情吗？

sentences.en: So the traditionalists would say, better a small, pure church than one that lets in everybody who wants to do everything, because then the church loses its sense.
sentences.zh: 所以传统派会说，宁要一个纯洁的小教会，也不要一个让所有想做任何事的人都进来的教会，因为那样教会就失去了它的意义。

sentences.en: You know, I went all around to Ireland before getting on the plane to go with Francis to Dublin.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在登上飞机随方济各前往都柏林之前，我走遍了爱尔兰各地。

sentences.en: And one thing I heard from Catholics all across the country was this real sense of betrayal that the church that they had loved had in a very literal way abused them.
sentences.zh: 我从全国各地的天主教徒那里听到的一件事，就是一种真正的背叛感，他们所热爱的教会以一种非常直白的方式虐待了他们。

sentences.en: For those who haven't given up hope on the church, what they don't particularly care about is a power struggle in Rome.
sentences.zh: 对于那些还没有对教会失去希望的人来说，他们并不特别关心罗马的权力斗争。

sentences.en: What they want is to rebuild a church on the ground that actually listens to them, that walks with them.
sentences.zh: 他们想要的是在基层重建一个真正倾听他们、与他们同行的教会。

sentences.en: And that is very much what Francis says needs to happen.
sentences.zh: 而这正是方济各所说的需要发生的事情。

sentences.en: But at the same time, if he's not going to take steps to remedy the crisis that caused the falling away of so many Catholics, it's going to be tough to rebuild something there.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，如果他不采取措施补救导致如此多天主教徒流失的危机，重建工作将会很艰难。

sentences.en: And so that's, again, why this attack is so powerful on him.
sentences.zh: 所以，这再次说明了为什么这次攻击对他如此有力。

sentences.en: It's because it's the very thing that has really punched Catholics in the gut all around the world.
sentences.zh: 因为它正是全世界天主教徒感到痛心疾首的事情。

sentences.en: And to say that Francis is not just not doing enough to solve the problem, but that he is the problem, that he's part of the problem, I think it's something that
sentences.zh: 而且说方济各不仅在解决问题上做得不够，他本身就是问题所在，他是问题的一部分，我认为这是许多天主教徒希望教宗直接回应，并向他们保证这不是事实的事情。

sentences.en: a lot of Catholics would want the Pope to respond to directly and to assure them that it is not true.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他的声望依然很高，但他需要确保那些将负责重建他教会的天主教徒不会对他失去信心。

sentences.en: I mean, his popularity is still strong, but he needs to make sure that the Catholics who are going to be responsible for rebuilding his church don't lose faith in him.
sentences.zh: 杰森，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Jason, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 这是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 这与此有关，他们过去称之为北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA），我们要称之为美墨贸易协定。

sentences.en: This has to do, they used to call it NAFTA, we're going to call it the United States-Mexico Trade Agreement.
sentences.zh: 我们要废除NAFTA这个名字。

sentences.en: And we'll get rid of the name NAFTA.
sentences.zh: 它有一个不好的含义，因为美国深受NAFTA之害。

sentences.en: It has a bad connotation because the United States was hurt very badly by NAFTA.
sentences.zh: 很多年了。

sentences.en: For many years.
sentences.zh: 现在这对两国来说都是一笔非常好的交易。

sentences.en: And now it's a really good deal for both countries.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统周二在白宫举行了简报会，宣布美国和墨西哥已经达成了他们自己的双边贸易协议，

sentences.en: President Trump held a briefing at the White House on Tuesday to announce that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这可能会取代北美自由贸易协定，那是一个也包括加拿大的三边协议。

sentences.en: and Mexico had reached their own bilateral trade deal that could replace the North American Free Trade Agreement, a trilateral agreement that also includes Canada.
sentences.zh: 总统正在通话。

sentences.en: The president is on the phone.
sentences.zh: 恩里克，

sentences.en: Enrique,
sentences.zh: 你可以帮他接通。

sentences.en: you can hook him up.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我什么。

sentences.en: Please tell me what.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事。

sentences.en: It's a big thing.
sentences.zh: 很多人在等着。

sentences.en: A lot of people waiting.
sentences.zh: 在经历了一些技术故障后，墨西哥总统恩里克·培尼亚·涅托通过免提电话加入了总统的通话。

sentences.en: After some technical difficulties, the president was joined on speakerphone by the president of Mexico,
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统，

sentences.en: Enrique Peña Nieto.
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: President Trump,
